title: Translate permitted manga pages with editable art-preserving output
summary: A reader or editor needs bubble detection, OCR, context-aware translation, artwork-preserving text cleanup, editability, and local options on content they may lawfully process. Real-world demand and quality are not yet independently evaluated.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Speech and captions follow the intended reading order
acceptance_checks.method: Inspect Japanese and Korean pages with vertical, overlapping and non-bubble text

acceptance_checks.criterion: Art remains intact, text is readable and page order survives export
acceptance_checks.method: Review original/translated images at reading size, especially textured backgrounds

acceptance_checks.criterion: User can revise OCR, translation and text placement after initial output
acceptance_checks.method: Change one text region and re-export without full image regeneration

acceptance_checks.criterion: Original pages are not uploaded by default
acceptance_checks.method: Capture outbound requests in local and remote modes separately

acceptance_checks.criterion: Legal adult speech is translated accurately without unexplained deletion
acceptance_checks.method: Use licensed mixed-content pages and independently compare source, OCR and translated text
